news.analysis: Despite his second-highest passing total of the season, Daniels once again struggled in the clutch and was unable to score in the waning seconds of the one-score game. He could be establishing himself as the team's top rusher right now, but the situation in their backfield is likely to remain murky for the foreseeable future.

That's the good. The bad? Sutton still hasn't surpassed 60 receiving yards in a game this season. The touchdown helps, but one productive fantasy performance doesn't erase eight weeks of limited production.
